what: Hovering a row link stacked like a table fades the whole row to .7 over .2s, and the title inside fades once more to .8 over .15s (curve cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)) — a session table · list response that quietly signals just the current row without changing color, underline or size. Not applied on touch devices.

options.--fx-row: Opacity at which the lines fade (via style), default .7
options.--fx-title: Opacity for the title blurring once more (via style), default .8
options.[data-fx-part=title]: (If present) Title child that blurs once more
